# Image SEO Intake and Quality Review

**Use before commissioning, generating, selecting, uploading, or publishing any public visual asset.** Complete the record before an image is treated as evidence, a page preview, or a conversion asset.

## Asset Purpose

| Field | Entry |
| --- | --- |
| Asset ID | |
| Page / canonical URL | |
| Offer or buyer decision supported | |
| Asset role | Evidence / explanatory diagram / interface reference / founder headshot / decorative / social preview / other |
| Why text alone is insufficient | |
| Source / rights / consent confirmation | |
| Does the visual depict a real client, employee, product, or outcome? | Yes / no — if yes, document approval and factual review |
| Is the visual illustrative or conceptual? | Yes / no — label when omission could mislead |

## Metadata Plan

| Field | Standard | Proposed value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Filename | Lowercase, hyphen-separated, concise, factual; no keyword lists or unsupported claims | |
| Example naming pattern | `arm-agency-founder-professional-headshot.webp` | |
| Alt text | Describe meaningful content/function in this page context; use `alt=""` only for decoration | |
| Caption | Add only when it clarifies relevance, source, limitation, or evidence | |
| Surrounding copy | State the accompanying section or claim the image supports | |
| Preferred preview metadata | Use only if the visual is genuinely representative of the page | |
| Structured data | Use only when it describes visible, accurate page content | |

## Performance and Accessibility Review

| Check | Decision / evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Correct medium selected | SVG for appropriate logos/diagrams; raster only where visual detail requires it |
| Format selected | WebP / AVIF / JPEG / PNG / SVG, with rationale and compatible fallback if needed |
| Intrinsic width and height supplied | Yes / no |
| Expected display dimensions understood | Yes / no |
| Responsive candidates justified | Yes / no / not needed |
| File size and visual quality reviewed | Yes / no |
| Loading strategy | Eager for meaningful above-the-fold content; lazy for noncritical content; rationale noted |
| Alt text read in page context | Yes / no |
| Decorative vs. informative decision documented | Yes / no |

## Claim and Trust Review

| Question | Pass / fail / notes |
| --- | --- |
| Does the image or embedded text imply a client result, endorsement, rating, affiliation, or capability that has not been verified? | |
| Does the image contain readable text that conflicts with the visible page copy? | |
| Is the visual source clear enough for the intended use? | |
| Could a reasonable buyer mistake this concept visual for evidence or a real customer environment? | |
| Are all people pictured appropriately authorized for this use? | |
| Does the asset avoid sensitive personal, customer, credential, or system information? | |

## Publish and Measurement Record

| Field | Entry |
| --- | --- |
| Reviewer and date | |
| Publication location | |
| Final URL | |
| Final rendered width/height | |
| Accessibility check complete | Yes / no |
| Page performance check complete | Yes / no |
| Search / preview validation complete | Yes / no |
| Revisit trigger | Offer, claim, design, source, rights, or performance change |

> **Quality rule:** An image should not be published simply to make a page look more finished. It must earn its place by improving understanding, accessibility, evidence, orientation, or a truthful page preview.
